note: Bionic (aarch64-linux-android) replacements for the glibc native assets that upstream opencode bundles inside its bun standalone module graph. These cannot load on Termux/bionic (they NEED libc.so.6 / libstdc++.so.6), which silently disables fff file search, the internal file watcher (@parcel/watcher) and the PTY backend. swap_native_assets.py replaces them in place (equal-length, NUL padded). Regenerate with tools/transplant/build-bionic-assets.sh when opencode bumps the upstream deps.

assets.recipe: cargo build --release -p fff-c --features mimalloc (tag v0.9.4) + local patch: mimalloc global allocator + untagged mmap instance handle (Android scudo tags heap pointers >2^53, which breaks bun:ffi's JS-number pointer round-trip)

clang++ -shared -fPIC -std=c++17 -O2 -DNAPI_DISABLE_CPP_EXCEPTIONS -DWATCHMAN -DINOTIFY -DBRUTE_FORCE (src/*.cc + src/linux/InotifyBackend.cc + src/unix/legacy.cc) with node-addon-api@7 headers, then llvm-strip --strip-unneeded
cargo build --release in bun-pty/rust-pty with the vendored termios@0.2.2 patched to accept target_os="android" (its os/mod.rs only cfg'd linux/macos/bsd)
